name: io.github.yaotsakpo/inbin
description: No-signup email for AI agents over MCP: trial inbox, verification codes, parsed email events.

environmentVariables.name: INBIN_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your Inbin API key (starts with ink_live_). Get one at https://inbin.dev/dashboard.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional: Bearer <your-inbin-api-key>. Leave it out to use the five no-account tools (create_trial_inbox, await_trial_inbox, claim_trial_inbox, await_trial_inbox_claim, claim_connection_status). Every other tool needs the key.
